messages:
Luca P.: Morning all, first day here! My Okta invite says 'No org assigned' when I try to enroll MFA — can't access Google Workspace or 1Password. Who should I ping for seat provisioning? Screenshot: https://redwood-internal/diags/okta-error-123
Maya Chen: Hey Luca, welcome! I'm IT — can you paste your company email so I can check seat sync? :wave:
Luca P.: luca.p@redwood.ai — thanks Maya
IT-Bot: Ticket created: IT-4821 assigned to Maya Chen. ETA ~30m.
Ben R.: cc @Maya Chen I ran the bulk seat grant earlier this morning, might have missed the "eng-new-joins" OU for a few accounts.
Maya Chen: I can see the Okta record but no group membership. Kicking a sync now. @IT-Bot please re-sync groups for orgunit "eng-new-joins"
IT-Bot: Group sync started for OU=eng-new-joins. Status: in_progress
Priya S.: Quick note from security: once Okta enrolls enable passkey + phone MFA, then we'll push 1Password seats. If you need a hardware key (YubiKey) file a request in #people-ops.
Maya Chen: Sync finished — added luca.p@redwood.ai to eng-new-joins. Can you try logging in again?
Luca P.: Okay trying now — MFA prompt showed up, was able to set phone + passkey. 1Password still says "No access" though.
Maya Chen: 1Password provisioning is async, pushing the seat now.
IT-Bot: 1Password seat assigned to luca.p@redwood.ai. Invite resent.
Luca P.: Got the 1Password invite, set up master vault and SSH entry. Thanks. Google Drive still shows permission denied.
Maya Chen: Added you to Drive group "eng-team". Try accessing the team drive again.
Luca P.: Access confirmed, can see team folders. GitHub invite came through too but I don't have infra repo perms yet. @Sam R. can you add me?
Sam R.: Added you to the infra team and granted repo write on infra/* repos. You should see them now.
Ben R.: Welcome to Redwood! Quick checklist: join #eng and #devex, add your SSH public key to 1Password entry, complete the new-hire form, and opt into the onboarding sync session this afternoon. :tada:
Luca P.: Thanks everyone! One last question — Okta asked to "enroll device" for device trust. I'm on a personal Mac, do I need to enroll in Jamf/MDM?
Maya Chen: No Jamf needed for personal devices. The device trust flow is just passkey-based attestation and does NOT enroll your machine in MDM. If you want a company-managed laptop instead, ping People Ops.
Luca P.: Perfect, all set now. Really appreciate the fast turnaround :pray: :tada:
